svg.title: Projectile to satellite
svg.desc: Four projectiles launch horizontally to the right from the same high tower. Increasing launch speed produces three progressively longer paths ending at Earth’s surface. At circular-orbit speed, the fourth projectile circles Earth at constant altitude. All launch together on a shared clock; impacted projectiles stop while the satellite completes its orbit. A dashed level-ground comparison shows why neglecting Earth’s curvature underestimates the range. Tower height is exaggerated; air resistance and Earth’s rotation are neglected.
